headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Public Trend Signals
summary: Integrate public trend signals to improve ClearInstall's risk assessment capabilities, ensuring more accurate and up-to-date security checks for npm and PyPI packages. Enhance user experience by providing real-time updates on potential vulnerabilities before installation.
actions: Integrate Rust package analysis from rust-anything (5062) to cover additional binding.gyp command expansions and ensure comprehensive risk assessment.
Implement battery monitor integration with Wireless-Device-Battery-Monitor (2695) to alert users of potential performance impacts on devices running ClearInstal
Utilize the package verification mechanisms from phonebox (3814) to enhance real-time vulnerability scanning and provide more granular security insights during
